fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld -- full articleBody inline in the page's NewsArticle ld+json node, no HTML scraping needed) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, Mmegi's News RSS feed at /rssFeed/1) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record: S1-jsonld or S2-rss.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. "not_found", "http_500", "blocked_or_transient").

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary -- from ld+json (article mode) or the RSS teaser text (latest mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, taken directly from ld+json's articleBody (article mode only). Single html-entity-unescaped -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated ld+json keywords string, split into a list (article mode only). Observed to just be the headline's words re-joined, not real topical tags.

inLanguage.title: Language
inLanguage.description: ISO language code from ld+json (article mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name -- resolved from the ld+json Person object (article mode) or the RSS <author> text (latest mode). Often a generic "correspondent"/"staff writer" rather than an individual, but real reporter names also appear (e.g. on opinion pieces).

dateCreated.title: Date created
dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 creation date from ld+json (article mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json (article mode only).

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image thumbnail URL -- from ld+json's thumbnailUrl (article mode) or the RSS media:thumbnail element (latest mode).

image.title: Image URL
image.description: Lead image URL, resolved from ld+json's single ImageObject (article mode only).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Raw Organization object from ld+json (article mode only) -- name, url, sameAs social links, logo.

copyrightHolder.title: Copyright holder
copyrightHolder.description: Raw Organization object from ld+json (article mode only).

canonicalUrl.title: Canonical URL
canonicalUrl.description: mainEntityOfPage.@id from ld+json (article mode only) -- the site's own canonical URL for the article.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item (latest mode only).

pubDate.title: Publish date (RSS)
pubDate.description: RFC-822 publish date string from the RSS item (latest mode only).

imageUrl.title: Image URL (RSS)
imageUrl.description: Lead image URL from the RSS item's media:content element (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
